## Core Brand & Project Hub

- [The Ridge Mashobra – Official Project Profile](https://mashobrashimla.com/the-ridge-mashobra): Signature luxury mountain development at 2,100 m elevation in Mashobra, Shimla. Features 3 BHK and 4 BHK hillside villas, 25,000 sq.ft luxury clubhouse, EVAVO longevity wellness suites, heated pool, and panoramic Himalayan vistas.

## Regional Location Guides

- [Properties in Mashobra](https://mashobrashimla.com/locations/mashobra): 2,146 m (7,040 ft) elevation; peaceful forest sanctuary surrounded by virgin Deodar cedar reserves with AQI < 30 and 13 km proximity to Shimla.
- [Properties in Shimla](https://mashobrashimla.com/locations/shimla): 2,206 m (7,238 ft) elevation; Himachal Pradesh capital offering premier healthcare, educational institutions, historic British architecture, and urban mountain amenities.
- [Properties in Kufri](https://mashobrashimla.com/locations/kufri): 2,622 m (8,600 ft) elevation; alpine ridge renowned for winter snowfall living, Himalayan Nature Park, and dramatic mountain horizons.
- [Properties in Naldehra](https://mashobrashimla.com/locations/naldehra): 2,044 m (6,706 ft) elevation; serene golfing sanctuary framed by Lord Curzon's historic 9-hole golf course and ancient cedar trees.
